one_liner: Global crypto exchange and developer platform with REST, WebSocket, FIX/SBE, and agent-native (MCP) interfaces for market data, trading, wallets, and related services.
access_notes: Create API keys in your account; KYC/identity verification and account activation required. Regional restrictions may apply. Free Spot/Futures testnets are available for development.
mcp_notes: Official Binance MCP Server provided by Binance: https://www.binance.com/en/support/faq/detail/7a6e676e36fb455d96478932cb12d9f3
blocker_notes: Self-serve API keys but production use requires completed KYC/identity verification and is subject to regional availability/restrictions; strict rate limits and signed/HMAC requests apply.

evidence.quote: We support HMAC, RSA, and Ed25519 keys. For more information, please see API Key types.
SIGNED endpoints require an additional parameter, signature, to be sent in the query string or request body.
Go to [API Management] then click [Create API]… before creating an API key, you need to… complete identity verification.
you can use the Binance Spot Testnet and Futures Demo Trading to test your use cases for free.
